canonical_policy.versioned_material: Version-specific pages remain public only with an explicit version or applies_to boundary. Superseded material requires an archive reason and a visible historical or archive notice.
canonical_policy.redirects: Legacy URLs are aliases, not independent catalogue items. They remain noindex redirects to the maintained canonical identity.
